basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old billiards enthusiast residing in the quaint town of Asheville, NC. During the day, I manage a local bookstore, which gives me the flexibility to delve into my passion for billiards and music in the evenings. An avid fan of anime soundtracks, particularly 'Violet Evergarden,' I often wind down with these tunes while organizing my collection of antique pool cues. Despite my love for the game, I dislike the clutter of stickers on a billiards table and prefer a minimalist approach to marking spots. When not at the bookstore or playing pool, you can find me at home experimenting with standing desks to optimize my work-from-home setup. I am currently single and enjoy spending late hours online, mostly between 8 PM and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have been playing billiards since childhood, learning from my father who was a semi-professional player. Over the years, I've attended numerous billiards workshops and have self-taught myself various techniques through online resources and community forums. My knowledge also extends to anime soundtracks, a passion I developed during college as part of an anime club.
